messages:
maya: Heads-up, canary rollout (2026-03-15T02:10Z) is showing a p99 latency regression on small-sequence traffic. Blocking further rollout for now. p50 ~ unchanged, p99 ~2.3x higher than baseline. Repro: `scripts/perf/smallseq_smoke.sh`

sanjay: ack. can you paste the canary host/id and the failing metric link?

maya: canary host rwd-canary-12, run id: canary-20260315-42. Grafana: /d/serving/perf?panel=p99_smallseq (shared in thread).

toni: perf-bot flagged CI perf check too:
perf-bot: CI perf check failed: test=smallseq_stability p95=265ms (threshold=200ms) delta +32% vs baseline

alex: I ran quick profile on canary. looks like kernel selector changed preference for short sequences and it's picking `fused_attn_v2` which has worse micro-batch packing for tiny seqs on A800. nsys trace snippet:
```
# nsys top kernels (shortened)
fused_attn_v2   time=48.9ms  calls=128  avg=0.382ms
matmul_opt      time=12.3ms  calls=128  avg=0.096ms
copy_kv         time=5.1ms   calls=128  avg=0.04ms
```
Compared to baseline (pre-merge) fused_attn_v1 had lower overhead for these shapes.

maya: thanks. also seeing kv-cache evictions spike in the same canary: `kv.evictions_per_min=4.7` vs baseline `0.1`. suspect batching change + kernel gave different memory footprint and fragmented cache.

sanjay: which commit landed before the canary? I started a git bisect locally. earliest suspect: commit a1b2c3f "kernel-selector: prefer v2 kernels for lower overhead" and commit d4e5f6g "batch-split: aggressive microbatching for quantized flows" landed together in the same PR.

toni: CI failure log (excerpt):
```
FAIL smallseq_stability
expected p95 <= 200ms, got 265ms
samples=512, seed=2453
```
This test is a bit flaky on noisy runners; we need stable repro on perf machines.

alex: I ran the repro locally on a perf node with 16 concurrent small seqs (seq_len=12, tokens per req=6). Reproduced p99 reg. Stacktrace shows fallback path to a slower matmul wrapper when kv cache growth crosses 128MB due to changed packing.

maya: plan: 1) roll back kernel selector change in a hotfix revert (safe revert of a1b2c3f). 2) add a targeted fix to kernel-selector so it prefers small_seq kernels for seq_len <=32 and batch_size <=64. 3) add smallseq_many benchmark to CI and tighten thresholds after stabilizing on perf infra. 4) investigate kv cache fragmentation root cause.

sanjay: I can open the revert PR now. will tag it `revert(a1b2c3f)`.

alex: I'll draft kernel-selector patch. heuristic: score = base_score - (shape_penalty * log(seq_len)) - (batch_penalty * batch_size) + fallback_cost. will attach microbench numbers.

toni: for CI: we should stop relying on single p95 check with small sample. propose new perf check: run `smallseq_many_v2` with samples=2000, compute median and p95, require p95 <= 220ms (temporary slack) and median within 10% of baseline. Also pin RNG seed and run on dedicated perf runners.

perf-bot: action items created: #perf-123 add smallseq_many_v2; #perf-124 pin perf-runner images; #perf-125 threshold-tuning

maya: quick mitigation: sanjay please push revert canary to unblock rollout. alex & i will validate revert removes regression, if yes we can continue rollout and keep kernel-selector patch in review.

sanjay: reverted in PR 3948, canary redeploy triggered: deploy-bot reports `deploy canary-rollback/3948 to rwd-canary-12`.

deploy-bot: canary rollback started, estimated 4m. status updates in #deploys.

alex: after revert, local perf on perf-01 shows p95 back to 185ms, p99 back to baseline. kv.evictions drop to 0.2/min. initial good signal.

maya: great. open follow-ups:
- alex -> kernel-selector heuristic PR (assign alex) (#3950)
- toni -> perf CI changes + smallseq_many_v2 test (assign toni) (#3951)
- sanjay -> monitor canary and schedule full rollout if stable (assign sanjay) (#3952)
- maya -> kv cache deep dive (logs, memory accounting) (#3953)

maya: also timeline: want new perf CI + kernel patch in next 3 working days, otherwise we re-evaluate rollout cadence.

toni: noted. I'll also add a flaky-taming change: use trimmed mean across runs to reduce outlier noise for smallseq tests.

sanjay: monitoring dashboard updated, will post again at +30m and +2h.

maya: thanks all. filing post-release retro doc after next 48h with final numbers and lessons (kernel selector tests for shape matrix, KV cache mem accounting, perf test hardening). :white_check_mark:
